# Quantum K-Field Research Archive

> Public research archive by Krytronx and principal investigator P. Dwayne Esterline covering observational anisotropy, astronomical orientation geometry, precision oscillator metrology, rotating multispectral measurements, geometric and graph modeling, signal analysis, and related K-Field research. Use this file as a routing guide; do not attempt to assimilate the entire repository before consulting the machine index.

Canonical web archive: https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/
Canonical source repository: https://github.com/KrytronDwayne/Quantum-K-Field on branch `main`.

For efficient assimilation, read the human overview first, then use the sharded machine index and semantic extension to identify only artifacts relevant to the current question. Preserve distinctions among measured observations, mathematical reconstructions, framework interpretations, downstream comparisons, educational material, and applied engineering studies.

## Primary Entry Points

- [Repository README](https://github.com/KrytronDwayne/Quantum-K-Field/blob/main/README.md): Human-readable scope, research trajectory, terminology, repository map, public-release status, and recommended reading order.
- [GitHub Pages Archive](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/): Canonical web landing page and DataCatalog.
- [Start Here](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Start_Here/): Curated conceptual entry into the archive.
- [Student Reconstruction](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Student_reconstruction_process/): Step-by-step educational reconstruction paths.
- [Citation Metadata](https://github.com/KrytronDwayne/Quantum-K-Field/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Repository citation metadata and authorship.

## Machine and Semantic Discovery

- [Machine Index Manifest](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/index.json): Primary sharded machine-index manifest.
- [Semantic Extension Manifest](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/index.json): Entry point for semantic-web resources.
- [Dataset Catalog JSON-LD](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/dataset-catalog.jsonld): DCAT/Schema.org catalog of explicitly typed datasets and structured record collections.
- [Ontology Mappings](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/ontology-mappings.json): Internal field/concept mappings to Schema.org, DCMI, PROV-O, QUDT and IVOA semantics.
- [Field Reference](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/field-reference.json): Exact archive JSON/data-key semantics with explicit external URIs, units, reference-frame constraints and no-inference rules.
- [K-Field Internal Vocabulary](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/kfield-vocabulary.jsonld): Stable internal identifiers and scoped definitions for project-specific terms.
- [JSON-LD Context](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/context.jsonld): Reusable semantic prefixes and field mappings.
- [Page Registry](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/semantic/page-metadata.json): Canonical landing-page and dataset-profile routing.
- [Normalization Rules](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/normalization.json): Canonical terms, aliases, abbreviations and legacy spellings.
- [Category Index](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/category-index.json): High-level topical routing.
- [Keyword Index](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/keyword-index.json): Keyword discovery.
- [Term Locator](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/lookup/term-locator.json): Canonical term to taxonomy-shard routing.
- [Artifact Locator](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/lookup/artifact-locator.json): Exact repository path to artifact-shard routing.
- [Search Companion Index](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/machine_index/search-companion-index.json): Compact abstract companions for large or difficult-to-index artifacts.

## Core Research Foundations

- [Galaxy Analysis](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Galaxy_Analysis/): Galaxy-axis orientation, unit-sphere directional analysis, plane systems and Cell3 geometry.
- [Typed Graphs](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Typed_Graphs/): Dependency graphs, reconstruction kernels, closure records and typed graph structures.
- [Discovered Pathways](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Discovered_Pathways/): Derived projective, reciprocal, graph, harmonic, propagation and geometric extensions.
- [CMB Modulation](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/CMB_Modulation/): Reference-frame and observer-trajectory analyses.

## Experimental Records

- [OCXO Experiments](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/OCXO_Experiments/): Dual-OCXO D101 source data and precision metrology analyses.
- [Spectrophotometer Studies](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Spectrophotometer_Studies/): Rotating multispectral measurements and geometric/signal analyses.
- [Applied Devices Analysis](https://krytrondwayne.github.io/Quantum-K-Field/Applied_Devices_Analysis/): Applied mechanics, materials and device studies.

## Assimilation Procedure

1. Read `README.md` for archive scope, provenance and terminology.
2. Read `machine_index/index.json` and `machine_index/semantic/index.json`.
3. Resolve project terminology through `normalization.json`, `ontology-mappings.json`, and `kfield-vocabulary.jsonld` before interpreting names literally.
4. Use category/keyword/taxonomy routing to identify candidate records.
5. Resolve exact artifacts through `artifact-locator.json`; read only the relevant shard and primary source artifacts.
6. Use `.abstract.json` companions for discovery of oversized artifacts, then use the source artifact for authoritative detail whenever possible.
7. Do not count paired PDF/JSON/abstract representations as independent experiments solely because they are separate files.
8. Preserve exact units, coordinate frames, epochs, detector orientations, experimental configurations and processing parameters.
9. Treat geographic coverage separately from celestial/reference-frame variables. ICRS, RA/Dec, sidereal phase, observer trajectories and barycentric/CMB coordinates are not geographic `spatialCoverage`.
10. When synthesizing, distinguish source observation, computed result, inferred structure and later interpretation, and cite exact repository paths.
